description: Types of public municipal, regional, and provincial meetings represented in meeting-preparation workflows.

entries.label: Regular council
entries.description: A scheduled regular meeting of an elected municipal council.

entries.label: Special council
entries.description: A specially called meeting of an elected municipal council.

entries.label: Standing committee
entries.description: A meeting of a standing committee or equivalent body.

entries.label: Advisory committee
entries.description: A meeting of an advisory committee, board, or panel.
